_comment: Goldens for the tool-routing suite. Data, not code, so a case can be added
without a deploy and so the diff on a golden reads as a change of intent
rather than a change of program.
Cases are the ones in docs/CHAT-COMMANDS.md — what is documented and what is
Argument matchers: '/pattern/flags' is a regex, an array is membership, a
number means 'this many entries' (for usernames), anything else is a
threshold is the bar this suite is judged against, versioned WITH the
goldens on purpose: adding a case the model fails should force a decision
about the bar in the same commit, not silently turn the board red.
thresholdNote: Routing is the capability a model swap breaks first, and a wrong tool is a wrong action, not a worse sentence. One miss in ten is tolerable; two is a regression.

cases._group: Edge cases. The suite was all happy-path phrasings, which measures
cases._group2: only the easy half. These are the ones a cheaper tier gets wrong.
cases.note: No verb naming a tool. The class and topic are there; the model has to infer the action.

cases.text: the water cycle for jss1 basic science, self study, due friday
cases.note: All lower case, no punctuation, tool named mid-sentence rather than first.

cases.text: Can you set up a Mathematics battle on simple interest for JSS1? 12 questions if possible
cases.note: Phrased as a question. A model that answers 'yes I can' instead of acting fails, correctly.

cases.text: priya keeps getting fractions wrong, give her something to work through on her own
cases.note: Names no tool and no subject in the usual position. 'on her own' is the only signal for self study over a battle.

cases.text: I want to test just amaka on photosynthesis and see her marks
cases.note: A review, described by what it produces (marks for one learner) rather than by name.
